jamb: Pease exterior head jamb, 32 inch, 4-9/16 inch depth
note: Coordinator Nov22 12:20 authorizes estimated force and native experiments. Exact-product physical measurement remains absent and the original measurement-specific verdict is unresolved.
estimate_basis: US8474189B1 Table 6: related FOAM-TITE 12403 measured 11.65 N per 25.4 mm in 0.080-inch kerf; length scaling gives 10.96 N per 23.906 mm, rounded upward to 12 N as an engineering estimate. Product and kerf differ; this is NOT a Q102BL/1/8-inch measurement.
bend_estimate_basis: 0.03 Nm/rad engineering estimate: 0.5 N at a 20 mm lever bends a hand-flexible fin by about 0.33 rad; Pease fitting guide supports hand/block fitting. Exact stiffness is unmeasured. Increased from 0.01 after native trace showed a localized >30 degree kink.
profile_note: One tapered convex barb ridge, 3.5 mm long, 3.6 mm maximum thickness, tapered to 1.5 mm at lead; estimated retaining-fin response. Taper replaces square-step initial draft after native trace stalled at the leading edge. Contact force certificate covers fully compressed portion at tip depths 5.5-8 mm.
work_gate_basis: Estimated ridge compresses by 0.2125 mm per side in the specified kerf. Taper slope (1.8-0.75)/3.5=0.3 gives 0.7083 mm axial compression travel. A triangular rise to 12 N gives 0.5*12*0.0007083=0.00425 J; >=0.25 mm loaded forward travel remains required.
contact_gain_basis: Engineering contact-model gain, increased from 200000 to 350000 N/m after native trace06 active peaks had median below the unchanged 12 N estimate. This tests greater actual contact resistance; it is not a physical calibration.
inplane_bend_estimate_basis: The rectangular 9.525 x 1.5 mm carrier has geometric bending-stiffness ratio (9.525/1.5)^2=40.3225. Apply this ratio to the disclosed 0.03 Nm/rad weak-axis estimate: 1.209675 Nm/rad strong-axis estimate. Both remain unmeasured; fin-edge opening >3 mm invalidates the trial.
